dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible dorsal plane from the mid-section toward the posterior.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey; high median pixel intensity with sharp specular highlights along the dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, parallel linear rake marks visible on the left lateral surface of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, healed linear rake marks on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent and sharp central dorsal ridge creating a distinct peak in the 2D planar view.
